method.units: Milliseconds; positive change is slower. GC callbacks cover collections during each timed request. No network or model execution.
method.boundary: Public MyLLM.generate through complete consumption, response close and final result retrieval; instance construction, fixture creation, assertions and final instance close excluded.

final_noise_check.scope: Quiet B1 A1 A2 B2 repeats of two Ollama-to-Chat cases whose full-suite run overlapped the final pytest process. 15 samples and 3 warmups per run. Primary values retained rather than overwritten.

limitations: The final pytest process overlapped the end of the 60-case run; quiet ABBA and the additional Ollama-to-Chat repeats are used to assess those apparent changes.

The 60-case suite and the 18-case ABBA use f80e14be; final 51a1f88f changes only Responses scalar feedback loss handling and native stream ownership capture. Two native Responses cases were compared on original/f80/final sources in ABC/CBA order.
No claim about network latency, model inference, or workloads not represented here.
